# Queue CSV fixture v1

`queue_pipeline_v1.csv` is a reduced, offline fixture derived from the
2026-03-03 queue snapshot explored in Notebook 05. It preserves the complete
embedded dictionary, all 79 operational columns, the mixed secondary-header
row, and 13 unmodified source records.

The selected records cover regular SPWs, the single observed SPS shape,
rectangle and custom mosaic evidence, an exact exported duplicate, and both
sparse spatial-spectral groups. The fixture is regression evidence, not a
complete or current ALMA queue export.
